guide.summary: Public integration for other Harvest accounts (approval path unconfirmed). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.

composio.note: Composio manages OAuth for Harvest, so you can prototype without your own app. Create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret for launch if you need your branding.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes, since Composio provides a managed Harvest app. For production, bring your own if users should see your brand, you need specific scopes, or you want your own rate-limit quota.
reasons: Consent screen shows your app name instead of 'Composio wants to access your account'
Managed apps share rate-limit quota across all Composio users
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum polling interval
Custom scopes and branding need your own app

scenarios.label: Public integration for other Harvest accounts
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects many customers' Harvest accounts through an OAuth2 app you registered yourself.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; registration fields in c3, c9, c10

waiting.basis: No review or timeline was found in the Harvest docs; the dossier has no waiting-time evidence.

scenarios.approval: No provider review is described. You register the app and receive credentials; the listing form is a separate marketing step.

prerequisites.title: Harvest administrator login
prerequisites.detail: You must be logged in as an Administrator on your Harvest account to register an OAuth application.

prerequisites.title: Decide products and account mode
prerequisites.detail: Choose Harvest, Forecast or both, and whether the app supports multiple accounts. Docs advise the minimal scope.

steps.title: Draft app registration details
steps.detail: Prepare the app name, redirect URL and minimal product scope. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Registration values are ready to paste

steps.title: Register the OAuth2 app
steps.detail: As an administrator, create the OAuth2 application in the Developers section of Harvest ID and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and client secret

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Harvest auth config through Composio's API using your client ID and secret.

steps.title: Test with a second Harvest account
steps.detail: Connect an account outside your own company to confirm other users can authorize, and check for any admin prompts.
steps.done_when: The external account connects and tools work

steps.title: Optional: submit integration listing
steps.detail: Harvest has a form for an integration listing page with copy and images. It is not described as gating connections.

traps.title: Tokens expire after 18 hours
traps.detail: Each user's access token expires after 18 hours, so your agent must handle refresh.

traps.title: Redirect URL must match prefix
traps.detail: A redirect_uri sent in a request must start with the Redirect URL registered on the app.

traps.title: Managed app shares quota
traps.detail: The managed app shares rate limits across all Composio users and shows Composio's name on consent.

traps.title: Old docs are partly stale
traps.detail: The V1 API is deprecated and the GitHub OAuth page is an archived repository, so follow the V2 docs.

blockers.symptom: Cannot open the OAuth app registration page
blockers.what_it_means: Registration requires an administrator on your Harvest account.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask an account administrator to register the app or grant you the role.

open_questions: Is there any Harvest review or limit on unreviewed apps? Ask Harvest support or the integration team via the integration submission form.
Do customers' administrators need to approve or allow the app? Test with an external account and ask Harvest support.
Is there any approval waiting time? None was found; confirm with Harvest.
Some dossier evidence concerned Greenhouse's Harvest API (a different product) and was excluded; Harvest docs should be rechecked for anything missing.
